title: Disappointed
text:
Disappointed. We were so excited to find this size at such a good price. They do stack well and don't slide around.
However one lock was broken and one foot missing on the last container we took out of the box.
due to the size and we had already filled the others we did not attempt to return.
Was hoping for a tighter lock. Should have stayed with a name brand

product_metadata.title: IRIS USA 40 Qt. Plastic Storage Container Bin with Secure Lid and Latching Buckles, 4 pack - Clear/Black, Durable Stackable Nestable Organizing Tote Tub Box Sports General Organization Medium
features: MADE IN USA QUALITY – IRIS USA’s large plastic buckled and lidded storage tote is a perfect storage organizer that can fit all your items safely with the anti-break, durable polypropylene material made in the USA.

STACK THEM UP – The large plastic storage container bin tote has grooves on the lid and body for secure and stable stacking that allows for easy moving and saves space in your house, apartment, or condo.
BUCKLE UP – The storage buckles latch onto the large durable plastic lid to keep contents safely stored inside and protected from dust and liquids when securely buckled.
PULL HANDLE – Built-in pull handle on bottom of the large plastic container makes it easy to pull the plastic box container bin from any high shelves.
description: Life is messy and chaotic, so take control over what is closest to you. Take IRIS USA’s proudly made in the USA plastic storage bin with secure lid and buckles in your hands and organize the world around you. The grooves on the lid and body create a stable and secure stacking experience. The plastic totes and lids are also nestable when not in use to save on storage space. The buckles latches onto the durable plastic lid to keep your things safe, secure, and pristine inside. The built-in pull handle allows you to reach up and pull the plastic storage box from high shelves and places, making it easy and hassle-free to make the most of all of your storage space. Enjoy organizing by utilizing our 5, 12, 27, 32, 40, 53, and 72 Quart plastic storage totes. From simple organization of a cupboard to cleaning up the clutter in your rooms, sending your kid off to college or moving into a new house, we've got you covered with these selections. Let’s get organizing and make life a little easier.
